_comment: Pass lines are per index. A pass line measured on one index says nothing about another: the corpora differ in what they contain, so the population differs. v8b -- the corpus behind this index had no item-level (号) or sub-item text, and branch-numbered articles (e.g. 132-2) were absent from the index entirely; its numbers are recorded here as a historical baseline. v9 -- item and sub-item text is first-class; branch-numbered articles are present; the fidelity gates pass with zero violations, and honbun is scored on the full ground-truth denominator with no cross-filter (a gold article absent from the index scores 0, not dropped). This file is anchored by an out-of-repo digest (see tools/scripts/verify-gates-lock.py); values here are owner-locked baselines and must not be edited to make a run pass.

v0.2-aug-v8b-gemini.note: measured on the index built before item-level chunks existed

v0.2-aug-v9-gemini.note: v9 honbun is measured on the full ground-truth denominator: every honbun question whose gold article the eval specifies is scored, with no cross-filter against either an older corpus or this index. A question whose gold article is absent from the index scores 0 (a miss) rather than being dropped. Any decrease from the earlier provisional 78/97 reflects (a) branch-numbered questions now included and (b) index-missing gold now counted as 0 — the visualization of gaps the previous filter hid, not a regression. The pass line detects drift against this fixed, honest population.
